timing: Written before generating or fitting the boundary-pilot data.
purpose: Separate engine agreement, response-model misspecification, planned missingness, and structural nonidentification before any estimator-performance study.

threshold_conditions.shared: C01 and C02 use the same [-1.10, 0.00, 1.10] threshold vector; RSM and PCM are both data-generating-compatible.
threshold_conditions.heterogeneous: C01 uses [-1.60, 0.25, 1.35] and C02 uses [-0.45, -0.35, 0.80]; PCM is compatible and RSM is deliberately misspecified.

observation_designs.complete: Every one of 80 Persons is observed with all 4 Raters, 3 Tasks, and 2 Criteria; 1920 rows.
observation_designs.planned_connected: Each Person is observed by two adjacent Raters in a rotating ring and by every Task and Criterion; 960 rows and one connected Person-Rater component.
observation_designs.disconnected_negative_control: Persons 1-40 are observed only by R01/R02 and Persons 41-80 only by R03/R04, with every Task and Criterion; 960 rows and two Person-Rater components.

design.paired_randomness: Within replicate, Person measures and one uniform per complete response cell are shared across threshold and observation-design conditions.

fit_contract.PCM: FACETS Models=?,?,?,#,R3 versus Python JMLE PCM step_facet=Criterion.
fit_contract.RSM: FACETS Models=?,?,?,?,R3 versus Python additive JMLE RSM. No bias-interaction model is included.

locked_gates.input_counts: Every FACETS Table 8 modeled-scale/category Total count must exactly match an independent count from the retained rows.
locked_gates.rank_full_designs: Complete and planned_connected fits must have independent constrained adjacent-category design nullity zero.
locked_gates.negative_control: Every disconnected fit must have independent nullity at least one, Python InferenceReady=false, and must be excluded from direct engine and model-selection claims even if FACETS returns measures.
locked_gates.engine_agreement_main: For rank-full directly eligible fits, observation-weighted MAE <=0.01 logits, maximum absolute difference <=0.05 logits, and minimum within-facet Spearman >=0.999.
locked_gates.engine_agreement_threshold: For rank-full directly eligible fits, observation-weighted MAE <=0.02 logits and maximum absolute difference <=0.05 logits, separately for PCM criterion-specific thresholds and the RSM common threshold vector.
locked_gates.misspecification_direction: Within each replicate and rank-full observation design, the Python PCM-over-RSM log-likelihood gain per observation must be larger under heterogeneous thresholds than under shared thresholds. This is a directional implementation gate, not a chi-square test.
locked_gates.rounding: Umean=0,1,6 is authoritative for measures and thresholds. Umean=0,1,2 is an auxiliary Table 8 count/Outfit display only, with a separate Scorefile.

descriptive_only: Main-facet and threshold truth RMSE by condition/model.
AIC/BIC and log-likelihood differences between RSM and PCM.
FACETS subset-connection wording versus the independent expanded-design rank audit.
withheld_claims: No bias, coverage, false-positive, power, or estimator-ranking claim from two replicates.
No RSM threshold truth target is asserted under heterogeneous PCM generation; its pseudo-true common threshold depends on the design and Person distribution.
No result from the disconnected negative control is treated as a usable estimate.
No generalization to named scales, mixed category supports, recoding, threshold anchors, or multiple # facets.
